# India map geometry

Reused from the INDIA FeatureCollection embedded in the supplied original PumpPulse dashboard. Original attribution: [geohacker/india](https://github.com/geohacker/india). This is a legacy administrative dataset, not a current legal or survey boundary. Administrative names and disputed-boundary depictions are retained from that source. Bundled locally; map display needs no external tile service. No fictional well records from the old dashboard are included.
